title: Fourier expansion on the sign cube
statement: Let $\iota$ be a finite set, let $f:\{\pm1\}^{\iota}\to\mathbb R$, and let $x\in\{\pm1\}^{\iota}$. Then $f(x)=\sum_{S\subseteq\iota}\widehat f(S)\prod_{i\in S}x_i$, where $\widehat f(S)=\mathbb E_y[f(y)\prod_{i\in S}y_i]$ and the expectation is uniform over sign assignments.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on sign assignments
